rules.note: No video included in input. Estimated tokens = output duration × output width × output height × 24 fps / 1024; actual billing uses usage.completion_tokens.

Video included in input. Estimated tokens = (total input-video duration + output duration) × output width × output height × 24 fps / 1024, subject to a minimum counted duration of ceil(5 × output duration / 3); actual billing uses usage.completion_tokens.

sources.notes: BytePlus pricing documentation confirms the token formula, successful-generation-only billing, actual usage.completion_tokens settlement, the input-video minimum token floor, and the absence of draft pricing for Seedance 2.5.
Authenticated BytePlus ModelArk model card lists $10.70/M tokens without video input and $6.40/M tokens with video input.

verification.notes: Unit rates, resolution/aspect dimensions, token formula, minimum-token behavior, successful-generation-only billing, and provider-reported completion-token settlement verified against the authenticated ModelArk card, pricing documentation, and Seedance 2.5 calculator.
